# pve_node_hosts (Resource)

Content of /etc/hosts on a node (singleton; written via POST per API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_hosts" "example" {
data = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) The target content of /etc/hosts.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node (also the `terraform import` format).
